headline: Adani Ports Agrees to Acquire Amsterdam-Based Evos for $2.9 Billion
summary: Adani Ports & Special Economic Zone has agreed to acquire Amsterdam-based liquid storage operator Evos BV at an enterprise value of €2.6 billion ($2.9 billion).
why: Adani Ports & Special Economic Zone is a major port operator, and large cross-border acquisitions expand its international footprint in logistics and infrastructure.
